# Hash-pinned dev tools for CI lint/typecheck.
# Scorecard Pinned-Dependencies compliance — use with:
#   pip install --require-hashes -r .github/ci-requirements.txt
#
# IMPORTANT: --require-hashes requires *every* transitive dependency to be
# pinned with == and hashed here. A missing one fails the whole install, not
# just that package. `librt` was missing, which broke the "Install tools" step
# in both jobs that use this file — so the Python lint/typecheck job and the
# tealtiger-mcp job were failing before ruff or pytest ever ran, and had been
# merged past (see #559).
#
# Hashes cover what CI resolves: ubuntu-latest on Python 3.11, i.e. the cp311
# manylinux x86_64 wheel, with the sdist as fallback. Adding a Python version
# or a runner OS to these jobs means adding the matching wheel hashes.
mypy==1.19.1 \
    --hash=sha256:f1235f5ea01b7db5468d53ece6aaddf1ad0b88d9e7462b86ef96fe04995d7247 \
    --hash=sha256:19d88bb05303fe63f71dd2c6270daca27cb9401c4ca8255fe50d1d920e0eb9ba
mypy-extensions==1.0.0 \
    --hash=sha256:4392f6c0eb8a5668a69e23d168ffa70f0be9ccfd32b5cc2d26a34ae5b844552d \
    --hash=sha256:75dbf8955dc00442a438fc4d0666508a9a97b6bd41aa2f0ffe9d2f2725af0782
typing-extensions==4.13.2 \
    --hash=sha256:a439e7c04b49fec3e5d3e2beaa21755cadbbdc391694e28ccdd36ca4a1408f8c \
    --hash=sha256:e6c81219bd689f51865d9e372991c540bda33a0379d5573cddb9a3a23f7caaef
# The first hash is the manylinux x86_64 wheel; the second is the sdist, which
# was previously the only pinned artifact. ruff is written in Rust, so an
# sdist-only pin makes every CI run compile it from source rather than install
# a wheel. The wheel hash is listed first so CI installs it instead.
ruff==0.15.15 \
    --hash=sha256:48decfa11d740de4889de623be1463308346312f2409a56e24aa280c86162dc4 \
    --hash=sha256:b8dff018130b46d8e5bf0f926ef6b60cf871d6d5ae45fc9334e09632daa741d6
pathspec==1.1.1 \
    --hash=sha256:a00ce642f577bf7f473932318056212bc4f8bfdf53128c78bbd5af0b9b20b189
# Transitive dependency of mypy>=1.19 (`librt>=0.6.2`, non-PyPy only). Pinned
# and hashed because --require-hashes mode will not resolve it otherwise.
#
# Unlike mypy and pathspec, which ship `py3-none-any` wheels, librt is a
# compiled extension and needs a wheel hash per platform. Pinned here is the
# cp311 manylinux x86_64 wheel — what CI resolves — plus the sdist as a
# fallback. Note the sdist builds with a Rust toolchain, so a platform without
# a pinned wheel will attempt a source build; add the matching wheel hash
# rather than relying on that.
librt==0.16.0 \
    --hash=sha256:94aed6a8308818b91677957d1bd03188869cd7aeb23c5dba7912a6c0402f7602 \
    --hash=sha256:ac38d6d8d66bf3d744148dbbc0b8e193e195a51e364ed55e224631f5721891fc
